options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: aup_block_internet_until_accepted
options.description: For First Time AUP Behavior, Block Internet Access. When set, all internet access (including non-HTTP traffic) is disabled until the user accepts the AUP.

options.name: aup_enabled
options.description: Enable AUP. When set to true, AUP is enabled for the location. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-end-user-notifications)

options.name: aup_force_ssl_inspection
options.description: For First Time AUP Behavior, Force SSL Inspection. When set, Zscaler forces SSL Inspection in order to enforce AUP for HTTPS traffic.

options.name: aup_timeout_in_days
options.description: Custom AUP Frequency. Refresh time (in days) to re-validate the AUP.

options.name: auth_required
options.description: Enforce Authentication. Required when ports are enabled, IP Surrogate is enabled, or Kerberos Authentication is enabled.

options.name: caution_enabled
options.description: Enable Caution. When set to true, a caution notifcation is enabled for the location. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/configuring-caution-notification#caution-interval)

options.name: city
options.description: Geolocation of the IoT device.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: country
options.description: Country Name

options.name: default_extranet_dns
options.description: Indicates whether the default DNS server of the assigned extranet is used for the location. Applicable only when C(profile) is set to C(EXTRANET).

options.name: default_extranet_ts_pool
options.description: Indicates whether the default traffic selector IP pool of the assigned extranet is used for the location. Applicable only when C(profile) is set to C(EXTRANET).

options.name: description
options.description: Additional notes or information regarding the location or sub-location. The description cannot exceed 1024 characters.

options.name: display_time_unit
options.description: Display Time Unit. The time unit to display for IP Surrogate idle time to disassociation.

options.name: dn_bandwidth
options.description: Download bandwidth in kbps. The value 0 implies no Bandwidth Control enforcement.

options.name: extranet
options.description: The extranet resource that is assigned to the location. Applicable only when C(profile) is set to C(EXTRANET).

options.name: extranet_dns
options.description: The extranet DNS server configuration that is assigned to the location. Applicable only when C(profile) is set to C(EXTRANET).

options.name: extranet_ip_pool
options.description: The extranet traffic selector IP pool that is assigned to the location. Applicable only when C(profile) is set to C(EXTRANET).

options.name: geo_override
options.description: If this field is set to true, the latitude and longitude values must be provided. By default, it's set to false.

options.name: id
options.description: Location ID

options.name: idle_time_in_minutes
options.description: Idle Time to Disassociation. The user mapping idle time (in minutes) is required if a Surrogate IP is enabled.

options.name: iot_discovery_enabled
options.description: If this field is set to true, IoT discovery is enabled for this location.

options.name: iot_enforce_policy_set
options.description: Enforces IOT Policy set

options.name: ip_addresses
options.description: For locations: IP addresses of the egress points that are provisioned in the Zscaler Cloud. Each entry is a single IP address (e.g., 238.10.33.9). For sublocations: Egress, internal, or GRE tunnel IP addresses. Each entry is either a single IP address, CIDR (e.g., 10.10.33.0/24), or range (e.g., 10.10.33.1-10.10.33.10)).

options.name: ips_control
options.description: Enable IPS Control. When set to true, IPS Control is enabled for the location if Firewall is enabled.

options.name: ipv6_dns64_prefix
options.description: Name-ID pair of the NAT64 prefix configured as the DNS64 prefix for the location

options.name: ipv6_enabled
options.description: If set to true, IPv6 is enabled for the location and IPv6 traffic from the location can be forwarded

options.name: latitude
options.description: Required only if the geoOverride attribute is set. Latitude with 7 digit precision after decimal point, ranges between -90 and 90 degrees.

options.name: longitude
options.description: Required only if the geoOverride attribute is set. Longitude with 7 digit precision after decimal point, ranges between -180 and 180 degrees.

options.name: name
options.description: Location Name

options.name: ofw_enabled
options.description: Enable Firewall. When set to true, Firewall is enabled for the location.

options.name: other6_sub_location
options.description: If set to true, indicates that this is a default sub-location created by the Zscaler service to accommodate IPv6 addresses

options.name: other_sub_location
options.description: If set to true, indicates that this is a default sub-location created by the Zscaler service to accommodate IPv4 addresses

options.name: parent_id
options.description: Parent Location ID. If this ID does not exist or is 0, it is implied that it is a parent location. Otherwise it is a sub-location whose parent has this ID. x-applicableTo: SUB

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: ports
options.description: IP ports that are associated with the location.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: profile
options.description: (Optional) Profile tag that specifies the location traffic type. The criteria used for setting best possible value is as follows: When invoked with a partner API key, it automatically sets the profile attribute to CORPORATE. When invoked using public API, it automatically sets the profile attribute based on the following criteria: If the location has authentication enabled, then it sets profile to CORPORATE. If the location has authentication disabled and name contains guest, then it sets profil

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: ssl_scan_enabled
options.description: This parameter was deprecated and no longer has an effect on SSL policy. It remains supported in the API payload in order to maintain backwards compatibility with existing scripts, but it will be removed in future. Enable SSL Inspection. Set to true in order to apply your SSL Inspection policy to HTTPS traffic. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/deploying-ssl-inspection)

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: sub_loc_scope
options.description: Defines a scope for the sublocation from the available types to segregate workload traffic from a single sublocation to apply different Cloud Connector and ZIA security policies. This field is only available for the Workload traffic type sublocations whose parent locations are associated with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Connector groups.

options.name: sub_loc_scope_enabled
options.description: Indicates whether defining scopes is allowed for this sublocation. Sublocation scopes are available only for the Workload traffic type sublocations whose parent locations are associated with Amazon Web Services (AWS) Cloud Connector groups.

options.name: sub_loc_scope_values
options.description: Specifies values for the selected sublocation scope type.

options.name: surrogate_ip
options.description: Enable Surrogate IP. When set to true, users are mapped to internal device IP addresses. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-surrogate-ip)

options.name: surrogate_ip_enforced_for_known_browsers
options.displayName: Surrogate Ip Enforced For Known Browsers
options.description: Enforce Surrogate IP for Known Browsers. When set to true, IP Surrogate is enforced for all known browsers. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/zia/about-surrogate-ip)

options.name: surrogate_refresh_time_in_minutes
options.description: Refresh Time for re-validation of Surrogacy. The surrogate refresh time (in minutes) to re-validate the IP surrogates.

options.name: surrogate_refresh_time_unit
options.description: Display Refresh Time Unit. The time unit to display for refresh time for re-validation of surrogacy.

options.name: tz
options.description: Timezone of the location. If not specified, it defaults to GMT.

options.name: up_bandwidth
options.description: Upload bandwidth in kbps. The value 0 implies no Bandwidth Control enforcement.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: vpn_credentials
options.description: VPN User Credentials that are associated with the location.

options.name: xff_forward_enabled
options.description: Enable XFF Forwarding for a location. When set to true, traffic is passed to Zscaler Cloud via the X-Forwarded-For (XFF) header. Note: For sublocations, this attribute is a read-only field as the value is inherited from the parent location.

options.name: zapp_ssl_scan_enabled
options.description: This parameter was deprecated and no longer has an effect on SSL policy. It remains supported in the API payload in order to maintain backwards compatibility with existing scripts, but it will be removed in future. Enable Zscaler App SSL Setting. When set to true, the Zscaler App SSL Scan Setting takes effect, irrespective of the SSL policy that is configured for the location. To Learn More, see Deploying SSL Inspection U(https://help.zscaler.com/z-app/configuring-ssl-inspection-zscaler-app#conf
